name: Tooltip
summary: Short non-interactive helper text rendered from aria-label with generated bubble and arrow, hover and focus-visible visibility states, and tokenized surface styling.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Inline wrapper that owns positioning and receives the accessible tooltip text.

anatomy.name: bubble
anatomy.description: Generated text bubble rendered from the aria-label attribute.

anatomy.name: arrow
anatomy.description: Generated arrow that visually connects the bubble to the trigger.

states.name: hidden
states.description: Resting generated content state with zero opacity.

states.name: hover
states.description: Pointer hover state that reveals the tooltip.

states.name: focusVisible
states.description: Keyboard focus-visible state that reveals the tooltip.

behavior.name: contentSource
behavior.description: The generated bubble reads its text from aria-label; adapters that do not use CSS-generated content must preserve an equivalent accessible label or description.

behavior.name: visibility
behavior.description: Tooltip content appears on hover and keyboard focus without requiring a click.

behavior.name: nonInteractive
behavior.description: Tooltip content must remain short and non-interactive; use Popover when the floating content contains controls or rich structure.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Short supplemental text exposed through aria-label and rendered by the web tooltip bubble.

accessibility: Use Tooltip only for short supplemental text, not required instructions or interactive content.
Ensure the trigger is keyboard focusable when the tooltip is attached to a non-focusable element.
Reveal the tooltip on keyboard focus, not only on hover.
Do not rely on generated visual text as the only accessible name when the trigger needs a different label.

web.notes: Implemented with generated pseudo-elements in components/css/layout.css.

shopify.notes: Shopify Liquid can render the same tooltip wrapper and aria-label contract.
